testcase.system-out: Scenario: Create a part by double-clicking its template ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the new-document template chooser is open ✔ And the metric template folder is selected ✔ When the user double-clicks the standard metric part template ✔ Then the chooser closes ✔ And a new part document becomes active ✔ And its viewport contains no visible model geometry ✔ And its model browser displays an origin and an end-of-part marker ✔ And a new document tab is visible
